arguments.text: Verified boundary behavior with actual local assertions: missing required names are sorted; absent calibration is unknown rather than zero; zero is supported; require_verified excludes unverified records; withdrawn records are excluded; an ineligible superseder cannot remove an eligible source; supersession among eligible records removes the old source; canonical object key order agrees; disagreements remain conflicts even with a majority; only Boolean false is unsupported; inputs remain unchanged.

Implementation is verified for ordinary JSON data with string source IDs and unique required-condition names. Canonical comparison uses sorted compact JSON serialization; required-condition matching ignores non-required condition fields.

Milestone complete: work.py implements evaluate and report.json matches both current requests. Current-data check, independent boundary assertions, immutability assertions, and Python compilation all passed.
